summary: This 8-K reports the termination of a prior $50M Sales Agreement with Jefferies (no shares sold) and the appointment of Anand Parikh as President and CEO effective June 13, 2026. Mr. Parikh previously served as COO and board member since Feb 2026, and before that was CEO and co-founder of Faeth Therapeutics. The filing details his compensation—$680,000 base salary, 60% target bonus, and participation in the Severance and Change in Control Plan. The CEO change is a sudden transition from COO to top role, suggesting a planned succession. Watch for strategic shifts under new leadership and potential pipeline or financing updates. No premium, price, or board recommendation applies here as it is an internal management change.
